ToD_A03_M11_VO_S001_002.source_old: Good. The troll leader should be arriving soon, and when he does, we can begin to plan the next steps of this little expedition.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S001_002.source_new: Good. The troll leader should be arriving soon, and when he does, we can begin to plan the next steps of this little expedition.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S001_003.source_old: Greetings, Warlocks! Our forces be ready for our joint attack on da elves. As soon as we crush da elven forces to da south and weaken their borders, we can move towards Silvermoon itself and obliterate this vile kingdom once and for all!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S001_005.source_old: Much of da elves’ great power lies within da Runestones that shield this land. Those stones are exhausting our will and mind with their foul magic, while bolstering da elves’ own immortal powers. We cannot break this realm as long as dey stand.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S001_006.source_old: And when dey do… Quel’thalas will finally fall and the ghosts of my people avenged at last!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S001_006.source_new: And when dey do… Quel’thalas will finally fall and the ghosts of my people avenged at last!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S001_007.source_old: I sense that there are five of these stones along the borders of Quel'Thalas, each of which embodies a certain element, much like the stone I encountered on Caer Darrow. As soon as we find and absorb their power, the elves will crumble before us...

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S001_010.source_old: Excellent... those creatures will prove themselves in the upcoming battle. I look forward to seeing the terror in the eyes of the elves when death itself appears before them!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S001_010.source_new: Excellent... those creatures will prove themselves in the upcoming battle. I look forward to seeing the terror in the eyes of the elves when death itself appears before them!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S002_002.source_old: Brothers! The vile trolls have brought these monsters to desecrate our lands! Show them no mercy, for they deserve none!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S002_002.source_new: Brothers! The vile trolls have brought these monsters to desecrate our lands! Show them no mercy, for they deserve none!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S002_003.source_old: Rangers! Zul’jin has brought murderous invaders to our lands… destroy his base and bring me his head!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S002_003.source_new: Rangers! Zul’jin has brought murderous invaders to our lands… destroy his base and bring me his head!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S002_004.source_old: Da Elves are trying to ravage my camp, we be needing your help! You will die here without us!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S002_004.source_new: Da Elves are trying to ravage my camp, we be needing your help! You will die here without us!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S002_005.source_old: We be under attack by da Elves, where be our orcish allies?!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S002_005.source_new: We be under attack by da Elves, where be our orcish allies?!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S002_006.source_old: We be needing help! Send word to da orcs for reinforcement!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S002_006.source_new: We be needing help! Send word to da orcs for reinforcement!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S003_001.source_old: You do not belong here, savage beasts! Withdraw from these forests immediately… or suffer the consequences!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S003_001.source_new: You do not belong here, savage beasts! Withdraw from these forests immediately… or suffer the consequences!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S003_002.source_old: “Ironic tone” Oh, what an entrance! And you are…?

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S003_003.source_old: I am Lireesa Windrunner, Ranger-General of Silvermoon. Many lesser races have tempted the wrath of Quel’thalas over the centuries… all have been humbled. Let this knowledge guide you as you choose what happens next, brute!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S003_003.source_new: I am Lireesa Windrunner, Ranger-General of Silvermoon. Many lesser races have tempted the wrath of Quel’thalas over the centuries… all have been humbled. Let this knowledge guide you as your chose what happens next, brute!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S003_004.source_old: "laughs" Such delicious bravado, little elf, but we are the orcs… we are the HORDE… nothing that has stood against us has survived, and neither will you!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S003_004.source_new: Such delicious bravado, little elf, but we are the orcs… we are the HORDE… nothing that has stood against us has survived, and neither will you!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S004_001.source_old: The forest is coming alive! We are under attack!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S004_001.source_new: The forest is coming alive! We are under attack!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S005_001.source_old: These magical creatures hold great power within them, we must find more of them to absorb their essence.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S005_001.source_new: These magical creatures hold great power within them, we must find more of them to absorb their essence.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S005_002.source_old: This slaughter should further demoralize the Elves and increase my powers.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S005_002.source_new: This slaughter should further demoralize the Elves and increase my powers.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S006_001.source_old: Argh! The pain… I think I broke my arm… Help me! Someone, anyone!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S006_001.source_new: Argh! The pain… I think I broke my arm… Help me! Someone, anyone!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S006_002.source_old: Ahh.. the little loyal Shaman. How curious, I was just looking for a way to dispose of you discreetly, but you seem to have solved the issue for me. I suppose I should be grateful...
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S006_002.source_new: Ahh.. the little loyal Shaman. How curious, I was just looking for a way to dispose of you discreetly, but you seem to have solved the issue for me. I suppose I should be grateful...

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S006_003.source_old: What? How dare you! In the name of the Warchief I command you to get me out of here! The Warchief will...
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S006_003.source_new: What? How dare you! In the name of the Warchief I command you to get me out of here! The Warchief will...

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S006_004.source_old: Hahaha… The Warchief will do nothing, little one, for he will never know what happened here. You will die in this ditch… alone and weeping… while I secure the destiny I so justly deserve!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S006_004.source_new: Hahaha… The Warchief will do nothing, little one, for he will never know what happened here. You will die in this ditch… alone and weeping… while I secure the destiny I so justly deserve!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S006_005.source_old: Gul'dan! Damn you! You will die for this… mark my words… you will die for this!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S006_005.source_new: Gul'dan! Damn you! You will die for this… mark my words… you will die for this!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S007_001.source_old: This kingdom has stood for thousands of years, orc filth... the power of Quel’thalas will decimate you and your pathetic troll allies!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S007_001.source_new: This kingdom has stood for thousands of years, orc filth... the power of Quel’thalas will decimate you and your pathetic troll allies!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S007_002.source_old: Your threats mean nothing to me, frail elf! Stormreavers! decimate them!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S007_002.source_new: Your threats mean nothing to me, frail elf! Stormreavers! decimate them!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_001.source_old: The power of the Earth stone is mine! I feel the strength of stone in my bones!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_001.source_new: The power of the Earth stone is mine! I feel the strength of stone in my bones!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_002.source_old: The power of the Forest stone is mine! Let the wilds be withered and their beasts beset by madness!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_002.source_new: The power of the Forest stone is mine! Let the wilds be withered and their beasts beset by madness!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_003.source_old: Yes… the power of the Air Stone! The calm breezes of this realm shall give way to wall shattering whirlwinds!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_003.source_new: Yes… the power of the Air Stone! The calm breezes of this realm shall give way to wall shattering whirlwinds!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_004.source_old: The Water stone belongs to me! The waters that once gave life to these lands will now bring only death!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_004.source_new: The Water stone belongs to me! The waters that once gave life to these lands will now bring only death!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_005.source_old: The Fire stone is mine! With it, I shall burn this land to cinders!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_005.source_new: The Fire stone is mine! With it, I shall burn this land to cinders!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_006.source_old: Anar'alah belore… the orcs have destroyed our sacred Runestones! Rangers! Fall back to Tranquillien and send word to Silvermoon at once! They will pay dearly for this!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S008_006.source_new: Anar'alah belore… the orcs have destroyed our sacred Runestones! Rangers! Fall back to Tranquillien and send word to Silvermoon at once! They will pay dearly for this!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S009_001.source_old: This kingdom has stood for longer than your feeble mind can fathom, orc, proceed with your assault… and both the orcs and your pathetic troll allies will be eradicated…
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S009_001.source_new: This kingdom has stood for longer than your feeble mind can fathom, orc, proceed with your assault… and both the orcs and your pathetic troll allies will be eradicated…

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S009_002.source_old: Your threats mean nothing to me, frail elf! Stormreavers! decimate them!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S009_002.source_new: Your threats mean nothing to me, frail elf! Stormreavers! decimate them!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S010_001.source_old: You really think… that this ends with me, monster? We are the high elves of Quel’thalas and you cannot break us!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S010_001.source_new: You really think… that this ends with me, monster? We are the high elves of Quel’thalas and you cannot break us!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S010_002.source_old: I already broke you, little one…look around you, take in the death and the suffering... this is what awaits your kingdom and your entire insignificant race!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S010_002.source_new: I already broke you, little one…look around you, take in the death and the suffering... this is what awaits your kingdom and your entire insignificant race!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S010_004.source_old: They can try, and they will die. She’s all yours, Warlord Zul’jin, I present to you her soul as a gift…
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S010_004.source_new: They can try, and they will die. She’s all yours, Warlord Zul’jin, I present to you her soul as a gift…

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S010_005.source_old: When ya see da Loa, tell ‘em Zul’jin sent ya!.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S010_005.source_new: When ya see da Loa, tell ‘em Zul’jin sent ya!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_001.source_old: Several hours later, near the Stormreaver clan camp...
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_001.source_new: Several hours later, near the Stormreaver clan camp...

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_002.source_old: Welcome Warchief. Your arrival is timely.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_002.source_new: Welcome Warchief. Your arrival is timely.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_003.source_old: You’ve done well Gul’dan, now give me your report.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_003.source_new: You’ve done well Gul’dan, now give me your report.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_004.source_old: We have decimated the elves’ outlying defenses, killed their general and claimed the power of their Runestones for the Horde. Quel’thalas is open for conquest, the elves will be powerless against us.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_004.source_new: We have decimated the elves’ outlying defenses, killed their general and claimed the power of their Runestones for the Horde. Quel’thalas is open for conquest, the elves will be powerless against us.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_005.source_old: Very impressive, Gul’dan, you and your followers have proved your usefulness to the horde.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_005.source_new: Very impressive, Gul’dan, you and your followers have proved your usefulness to the horde.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_006.source_old: Wait…where’s Utok? I gave him a direct order to stay by your side.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_006.source_new: Wait…where’s Utok? I gave him a direct order to stay by your side.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_007.source_old: That you did, however… I told him to scout ahead to locate the best possible route to the elven capital. He should be reporting back to camp shortly.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_007.source_new: That you did, however… I told him to scout ahead to locate the best possible route to the elven capital. He should be reporting back to camp shortly.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_008.source_old: Hmmmm, very well. Zuluhed… it’s time to unleash this ‘weapon’ that you promised me, burn this land to ashes!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_008.source_new: Hmmmm, very well. Zuluhed… it’s time to unleash this ‘weapon’ that you promised me, burn this land to ashes!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_010.source_old: Come my warriors! Onwards to Silvermoon!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S011_010.source_new: Come my warriors! Onwards to Silvermoon!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S012_001.source_old: The Horde's dragons set fire to the ancient forests of Quel'thalas, sowing death and chaos among its people.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S012_001.source_new: The Horde's dragons set fire to the ancient forests of Quel'thalas, sowing death and chaos among its people.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S012_002.source_old: Meanwhile, the Horde's army closed in on the city of Silvermoon, and started a siege.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S012_002.source_new: Meanwhile, the Horde's army closed in on the city of Silvermoon, and started a siege.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S012_003.source_old: The Siege of Silvermoon lasted for nearly a month, testing Orgrim Doomhammer's patience to its limits.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S012_003.source_new: The Siege of Silvermoon lasted for nearly a month, testing Orgrim Doomhammer's patience to its limits.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S012_004.source_old: In fear of the Alliance potentially encircling the horde's army in Quel'thalas, the Warchief decided to lead the Blacktooth Grin and Dragonmaw clans back to Lordaeron.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S012_004.source_new: In fear of the Alliance potentially encircling the horde's army in Quel'thalas, the Warchief decided to lead the Blacktooth Grin and Dragonmaw clans back to Lordaeron.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S012_005.source_old: He ordered Gul'dan and Zul'jin to continue the siege till magical barriers of the elves are exhausted and the city falls under the countless attacks of the Horde.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S012_005.source_new: He ordered Gul'dan and Zul'jin to continue the siege till magical barriers of the elves are exhausted and the city falls under the countless attacks of the Horde.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_001.source_old: |cffffdd00Cho:|r Master, the elven defenses are broken. We are ready to crush Quel'Thalas and wipe the elves from the face of this world!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_001.source_new: |cffffdd00Cho:|r Master, the elven defenses are broken. We are ready to crush Quel'Thalas and wipe the elves from the face of this world!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_002.source_old: That will not be necessary, my apprentice. We have what we came for. Gather our troops and make for the coast. The Stormreaver fleet will have a long journey ahead of it.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_002.source_new: That will not be necessary, my apprentice. We have what we came for. Gather our troops and make for the coast. The Stormreaver fleet will have a long journey ahead of it.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_003.source_old: What?! You be leaving now?! When are but one step away from complete victory over da elves? When I made my pact with da Horde - Doomhammer himself gave me his word that da Horde would return these lands to da Amani!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_003.source_new: What?! You be leaving now?! When are but one step away from complete victory over da elves? When I made my pact with da Horde - Doomhammer himself gave me his word that da Horde would return these lands to da Amani!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_004.source_old: I am not Doomhammer, little troll... and he is nothing to me! I didn't come here to return this realm to you insignificant savages... I came to seize its power... and with it... I will bring this wretched world to its knees.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_004.source_new: I am not Doomhammer, little troll... and he is nothing to me! I didn't come here to return this realm to you insignificant savages... I came to seize its power... and with it... I will bring this wretched world to its knees.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_005.source_old: You are but pawns in a much greater game... and when it is finished, you and all of creation will bow before me.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_005.source_new: You are but pawns in a much greater game... and when it is finished, you and all of creation will bow before me.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_006.source_old: Traitor! Oathbreaker! Your selfish betrayal of da Horde will lead to your death! I have seen your kind before, blinded by greed and arrogance, and their fates have all been the same. Your end will be slow, cruel and agonizing… and when you realize the error of the path you have chosen… it will be too late. This be my curse upon you, Warlock!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_007.source_old: |cffffdd00Cho:|r We do not understand, Master, what could be more important than victory in the war? |n|cffffdd00Gall:|r What power are you talking about?
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_007.source_new: |cffffdd00Cho:|r We do not understand, Master, what could be more important than victory in the war? |n|cffffdd00Gall:|r What power are you talking about?

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_008.source_old: Come with me, my apprentice, and see with your own eyes what awaits us.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S013_008.source_new: Come with me, my apprentice, and see with your own eyes what awaits us.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S014_003.source_old: Well, well, well… a commander who fell into a ditch and couldn’t get out… I thought better of you… Utok.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S014_003.source_new: Well, well, well… a commander who fell into a ditch and couldn’t get out… I thought better of you… Utok.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S014_004.source_old: Tharbek…this is not the time to gloat, We are in a very serious situation!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S014_004.source_new: Tharbek…this is not the time to gloat, We are in a very serious situation!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S014_005.source_old: Scratcher…. your Warlock has betrayed us! The whole army has withdrawn, except for a few grunts, leaving my people and I to fend for ourselves! This is a great disgrace for all of your kind!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S014_005.source_new: Scratcher…. your Warlock has betrayed us! The whole army has withdrawn, except for a few grunts, leaving my people and I to fend for ourselves! This is a great disgrace for all of your kind!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S014_006.source_old: Gul’dan has betrayed us all, Zul’jin… he left me to die in this pit… help me get me out of here, mighty Zul’jin… Gul’dan must not get away with this!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S014_006.source_new: Gul’dan has betrayed us all, Zul’jin… he left me to die in this pit… help me get me out of here, mighty Zul’jin… Gul’dan must not get away with this!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S015_001.source_old: You are in my debt now, Scratcher. I have saved your life... and so you and your remaining brethren  must help me defend Zul'Aman. Soon da elves will regroup and strike back. Honour da pact, Utok!  Without da Horde at our back, my people will be wiped out!
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S015_001.source_new: You are in my debt now, Scratcher. I have saved your life... and so you and your remaining brethren  must help me defend Zul'Aman. Soon da elves will regroup and strike back. Honour da pact, Utok!  Without da Horde at our back, my people will be wiped out!

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S015_002.source_old: You have suffered a great injustice today Zul’jin. Tharbek and the rest of my warriors are yours to command… I pray they will be enough. As for me, I cannot join you… the Warchief must know what happened here… I must depart at once...
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S015_002.source_new: You have suffered a great injustice today Zul’jin. Tharbek and the rest of my warriors are yours to command… I pray they will be enough. As for me, I cannot join you… the Warchief must know what happened here… I must depart at once...

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S015_003.source_old: I would’ve gladly cleaved that filthy Warlock’s head in the Warchief’s honor, but I was ordered to remain at Zul’jin’s side at all costs... go with the wind Utok, we will prove our mettle another time.
ToD_A03_M11_VO_S015_003.source_new: I would’ve gladly cleaved that filthy Warlock’s head in the Warchief’s honor, but I was ordered to remain at Zul’jin’s side at all costs... go with the wind Utok, we will prove our mettle another time.

ToD_A03_M11_VO_S015_004.source_old: That cursed warlock will be da doom of da Horde…. Do what you must… I will return to my homeland to defend it. Bring my regards to Rend and Orgrim, let them know that my fight continues...
